findings.description: The RLS policies in migration 09 take effect only after the user applies the migration to their Supabase project. Without this manual step, teachers will still encounter permission denied errors despite the improved error messages in the code.
findings.action: Ensure the user has clear instructions on running `supabase db push` or applying the migration via the Supabase dashboard before testing.

findings.description: The cover upload uses `Date.now()` for uniqueness, which produces a single timestamp per millisecond. If two teachers upload simultaneously from the same competition, the filename could collide and the second upload would overwrite the first.
findings.action: Consider using UUID or random suffix for complete uniqueness, though this collision is unlikely in practice.
